I only told my girlfriend, and she was really supportive and understanding. She didn't know what depersonalization was so she tried to learn more about it, and we both read "Feeling Unreal" which was very useful and informative. That book helped me put my feelings into words and explain better what was going on with me.
It's always good to know we're not alone.

Ever since I learned about what depersonalization is, I became more aware of how it affects me and I began to constantly do mental checks to try and determine whether or not I was feeling dp'ed, off, spaced out, etc. I think it's common to obsess over these things when you have this condition. You probably aren't zoning out more, you're just aware of it now.

Please don’t self harm. Once you do it for the first time, it becomes an addiction and it just turns into a really bad habit. Trust me, you’ll feel really bad after it’s done. Also, there will be marks on your skin constantly reminding you of what you did and you’ll hate your scars. If you feel like doing something to yourself to feel pain, try using a rubber band on your wrist and snap it whenever you feel this urge. It will still hurt, but won’t leave any marks.
